_notes: Bosses of The Lashings. Hand-authored in tools/build_lashings_content.py; spread checked by its audit().

Bosun Grell Tarpot.name: Starter's Knotted Rope
Bosun Grell Tarpot.flavor_text: A bosun's rope has one knot for calling the watch and three for the other thing.

Bosun Grell Tarpot.name: Bosun's Tarred Jerkin
Bosun Grell Tarpot.flavor_text: Tarred against weather on a ship that has not met weather in twenty years.

Bosun Grell Tarpot.name: Deck-Caller's Gorget
Bosun Grell Tarpot.flavor_text: He could be heard the length of nine hulls and he knew it.

Bosun Grell Tarpot.name: Hulk-Walker's Boots
Bosun Grell Tarpot.flavor_text: Soled for wet planking, which out here is all the planking.

Sailmaker Oona Flay.name: Flay's Sailmaker's Needle
Sailmaker Oona Flay.flavor_text: Six inches of steel for canvas, and canvas is not what it has been through.

Sailmaker Oona Flay.name: Stitched-Canvas Hauberk
Sailmaker Oona Flay.flavor_text: Sailcloth, folded eleven times and sewn by somebody with nothing else to do.

Sailmaker Oona Flay.name: Sailmaker's Palm
Sailmaker Oona Flay.flavor_text: The leather pad a sailmaker drives a needle with. Hers is worn through twice.

Sailmaker Oona Flay.name: Unfurled Mantle
Sailmaker Oona Flay.flavor_text: Nobody on this fleet has unfurled anything in twenty years.

Powder-Master Juss Wick.name: Wick's Linstock
Powder-Master Juss Wick.flavor_text: A yard of match-cord on a pole, and he has never once been seen to hurry.

Powder-Master Juss Wick.name: Powder-Hulk Breastplate
Powder-Master Juss Wick.flavor_text: Scorched in four places and holed in none, which is a career summary.

Powder-Master Juss Wick.name: Slow-Match Bracers
Powder-Master Juss Wick.flavor_text: They smell of it. Everything of his does.

Powder-Master Juss Wick.name: Charge-Counter's Cap
Powder-Master Juss Wick.flavor_text: Forty-one barrels, and he could tell you where every one of them was.

Quartermaster Nadd Kell.name: The Share-Out Blade
Quartermaster Nadd Kell.flavor_text: A quartermaster settles disputes. This is how the ones that will not settle end.

Quartermaster Nadd Kell.name: Prize-Court Legguards
Quartermaster Nadd Kell.flavor_text: Everything that came aboard was logged before it was divided. Everything.

Quartermaster Nadd Kell.name: Ledger-Keeper's Grips
Quartermaster Nadd Kell.flavor_text: Ink in the seams, four years deep.

Quartermaster Nadd Kell.name: Fair-Shares Girdle
Quartermaster Nadd Kell.flavor_text: Fair by the articles, which is not the same as fair.

Captain Ardessa Rake.name: Rake's Boarding Cutlass
Captain Ardessa Rake.flavor_text: She is the one who was good at it. That is the whole difference between this cove and the Barrens.

Captain Ardessa Rake.name: Captain's Rated Plate
Captain Ardessa Rake.flavor_text: Kept like a ship, on the one hull in this cove that still is one.

Captain Ardessa Rake.name: Twenty-Years-at-Anchor Spaulders
Captain Ardessa Rake.flavor_text: She has not sailed since the sky changed and she has not stopped being a captain.

Captain Ardessa Rake.name: Articles of the Southsea
Captain Ardessa Rake.flavor_text: Signed by every hand aboard. The first signature is a cross and it is hers.
